summary: Eren is gone. Erwin, Levi, Hange, and the 104th become a hunting party. The forest ahead is a deadline, not a refuge.

segments.ja: 近接が終わった地面の中心に、エレンはいません。いないことが、今日のすべての命令の主語になります。ミカサはその主語を、自分の失敗として一度抱え、すぐに方角へ変換します。変換が遅いと、鎧は壁の外の森まで行きます。行く先を、アルミンは地図の上で先に指します。指した先は、巨木の森です。森は、前の遠征の記憶と重なります。重なる記憶を、今日は罠ではなく追撃の道として使います。
segments.en: At the center of the ground where the close combat ended, Eren is not there. His not being there becomes the subject of every order today. Mikasa holds that subject once as her own failure, and immediately converts it into a direction. If the conversion is late, the armor reaches the forest outside the wall. Armin points at the destination ahead of them, on the map. The place he points to is the forest of giant trees. The forest overlaps with the memory of the previous expedition. They use the overlapping memory today not as a trap but as the road of pursuit.

segments.ja: 追う隊を出すには、駐屯と調査の両方の許可が要ります。要る許可を、ピクシスは短く出します。出す理由は、エレンが壁の内の最大の戦力だからです。戦力という言葉を、ハンネスは隣で人間の名に聞き換えます。聞き換えても、司令の判断は同じです。同じ判断が、馬と刃を南の門へ集めます。集める速度が、今日の狩りの最初の技術です。技術は、哀悼の時間を削ります。
segments.en: Sending a pursuing squad needs permission from both the garrison and the survey. Pyxis gives the needed permission, briefly. The reason for giving it is that Eren is the greatest fighting power inside the walls. Beside him, Hannes translates the word fighting power into a human name. Even translated, the commander's judgment is the same. The same judgment gathers horses and blades at the southern gate. The speed of gathering is the first technique of today's hunt. The technique shaves away the time for mourning.

segments.ja: エルヴィンは、追う列の先頭に自分を置きます。置くことは、団長の見栄ではありません。見栄なら、情報の処理に残るはずです。残らずに出る理由は、時間です。時間は、鎧が森で足を止める前にこちらが届くかどうかで測られます。測る顔は、損失をすでに次の配置へ変換しています。変換を、リヴァイは質問せずに横で受けます。受けることが、二人のいつもの速度です。
segments.en: Erwin puts himself at the front of the pursuing column. Putting himself there is not the Commander's vanity. If it were vanity, he would stay with the processing of information. The reason he goes out instead of staying is time. Time is measured by whether this side arrives before the armor stops its feet in the forest. The face that measures has already converted losses into the next arrangement. Levi receives the conversion beside him without a question. Receiving it is the two men's usual speed.

segments.ja: リヴァイが出る条件は、エレンを生かすことと、相手を仕留めることを同じ行に書くことです。書く行は、感情の報告を含みません。含まない行を、ミカサは冷たいと感じ、しかし従います。従う理由は、冷たい行のほうがエレンに届くからです。届く行の実行は、森の中の立体機動です。立体機動は、平地の近接より速く、そして枝の上でしか成立しません。成立する場所へ、列は馬で直行します。
segments.en: Levi's condition for going is to write, on the same line, keeping Eren alive and finishing the opponent. The line he writes does not include an emotional report. Mikasa feels the line that does not include one is cold, and she obeys. The reason she obeys is that the cold line is the one that reaches Eren. Carrying out the line that reaches him is ODM gear inside the forest. ODM gear is faster than close combat on flat ground, and it only holds on the branches. The column rides straight for the place where it holds.

segments.ja: ハンジは、壁の上の蒸気で体を損なっています。損なった体で、なお追う列に情報を渡します。渡す情報は、鎧の関節と、超大型の制限です。制限は、巨大な体を長く維持できないことです。できない制限が、日没までの期限を作ります。期限を、モブリットは彼女の包帯の横で書き留めます。書き留める手が、今日の狩りの時計です。時計は、同情では遅れません。
segments.en: Hange's body is damaged by the steam on the wall. With the damaged body, she still passes information to the pursuing column. The information she passes is the armor's joints, and the Colossal's limit. The limit is that a huge body cannot be maintained for long. The limit that cannot be maintained makes a deadline until sunset. Moblit writes the deadline down beside her bandages. The hand that writes it down is the clock of today's hunt. The clock does not run late out of sympathy.

segments.ja: ミカサ、アルミン、ジャン、コニー、サシャ、ヒストリア。追う列の中に、訓練の同期が混ざります。混ざる顔は、ライナーとベルトルトを敵として見る準備が揃っていません。揃っていない顔を、エルヴィンは外しません。外さない理由は、現場を知る目が要るからです。要る目は、同時に揺らぎます。揺らぐ目を、アルミンが言葉で固定します。固定した言葉は、正体はもう分かった、です。分かったあとの手順だけが残ります。
segments.en: Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Connie, Sasha, Historia. Classmates from training are mixed into the pursuing column. The mixed faces are not ready to see Reiner and Bertholdt as enemies. Erwin does not remove the faces that are not ready. The reason he does not remove them is that he needs eyes that know the scene. The needed eyes waver at the same time. Armin fixes the wavering eyes with words. The words he fixes them with are that the identity is already known. Only the procedure after knowing remains.

segments.ja: ハンネスは、調査兵団の列に駐屯の顔で加わります。加わる理由を、彼は英雄の志願とは言いません。言わない代わりに、エレンをシガンシナから知っている、とだけ置きます。置いた一文が、彼の今日の資格です。資格は、立体機動の技量では測れません。測れない資格を、エルヴィンは拒否しません。拒否しないことが、この狩りの人間の幅です。幅の中に、後で笑って死ぬ場所がすでに混ざっています。
segments.en: Hannes joins the Survey Corps column with a garrison face. He does not call the reason for joining a hero's volunteer offer. Instead he only sets down that he has known Eren since Shiganshina. The one sentence he sets down is his qualification today. The qualification cannot be measured by skill with ODM gear. Erwin does not refuse the qualification that cannot be measured. Not refusing is the human width of this hunt. Inside the width, a place to die while still smiling is already mixed in.

segments.ja: 先遣隊は、本隊より先に森の入口を見ます。見る仕事は、敵の速度を本隊へ返すことです。返す煙と伝令が、狩りの脈です。脈が途切れると、鎧は姿を消します。消さないために、少人数が危険な先行を引き受けます。引き受ける顔に、ジャンがいます。いる理由は、マルコのあとで選んだ翼が、今日も追跡を含むからです。含む翼を、彼はもう快適な内地の席とは比べません。
segments.en: The advance party sees the entrance of the forest ahead of the main body. The work of seeing is to return the enemy's speed to the main body. The smoke and messengers that return it are the pulse of the hunt. If the pulse breaks, the armor disappears. To keep it from disappearing, a few people take on a dangerous lead. Jean is among the faces that take it on. The reason he is there is that the wings he chose after Marco still include pursuit today. He no longer compares the wings that include it with a comfortable seat in the interior.

segments.titleEn: The ordinary day does not return
segments.ja: 追う馬の上で、同期は昨日までの日常を一度ずつ捨てます。捨てる日常は、飯の席、訓練の冗談、ライナーが世話を焼いた夜です。焼いた世話が、任務の擬態だったと知ることは、腹を垂直に裂くのに似ています。似た痛みを、コニーは村の巨人の顔と接続します。接続は、まだ証明ではありません。証明でなくても、追う理由は増えます。増えた理由は、エレン一人ではなくなります。
segments.en: On the pursuing horses, the classmates throw away the ordinary day up to yesterday, one piece at a time. The ordinary day they throw away is a seat at a meal, a joke in training, a night when Reiner fussed over them. Knowing that the fussing was a mimicry of a mission is like splitting the stomach vertically. Connie connects the similar pain to the face of the Titan in his village. The connection is not proof yet. Even without proof, the reasons to pursue increase. The increased reasons are no longer Eren alone.

segments.en: In the column, only Historia holds Ymir's absence as a different pain. The pain she holds is not joy that an enemy's ally has decreased. She does not put out the pain that is not joy in the form of opposing the survey plan. Instead of putting it out, she says a name once, small, on the horse. The name she says is not Christa. It is the way of calling on her own side. The way of calling keeps her in the pursuing column both as a soldier and as a person. The position that remains is not fully decided yet.

segments.en: When the giant trees come into sight, the hunters prepare to leave the horses and go up into the branches. The preparation is different from the waiting of the previous expedition. The difference is that today there is no order to wait. In place of the order that is not there, there is a deadline of sunset. Inside the deadline, they locate Eren and separate him from the armor. Levi distributes the procedure of separating, briefly. The distribution is a shape in which the column does not stop no matter who dies. Mikasa accepts the shape, and looks at the branches with the eyes that accepted it.

The herd that is not sorted narrows the hunt's path. Ahead of the narrowed path, the danger grows thick that someone's body will come out in front of a Titan's mouth. Erwin does not make the thickening danger a reason to slow down. The face that does not is the entrance of the next scene. Nobody has shouted the name of the entrance yet.

segments.en: While running, Armin tries to cut away the night he was looked after by Reiner. The memory he tries to cut will not cut. vocab.exampleJa: 近接が終わった地面の中心に、エレンはいません。
vocab.exampleEn: At the center of the ground where the close combat ended, Eren is not there. His not being there becomes the subject of every order today. Mikasa holds that subject once as her own failure, and immediately converts it into a direction. If the conversion is late, the armor reaches the forest outside the wall. Armin points at the destination ahead of them, on the map. The place he points to is the forest of giant trees. The forest overlaps with the memory of the previous expedition. They use the overlapping memory today not as a trap but as the road of pursuit.

vocab.exampleEn: Erwin puts himself at the front of the pursuing column. Putting himself there is not the Commander's vanity. If it were vanity, he would stay with the processing of information. The face that measures has already converted losses into the next arrangement. Levi receives the conversion beside him without a question. Receiving it is the two men's usual speed.

The ordinary day they throw away is a seat at a meal, a joke in training, a night when Reiner fussed over them. Knowing that the fussing was a mimicry of a mission is like splitting the stomach vertically. Connie connects the similar pain to the face of the Titan in his village. The connection is not proof yet. Even without proof, the reasons to pursue increase. The increased reasons are no longer Eren alone.

vocab.exampleJa: 要る目は、同時に揺らぎます。
vocab.exampleEn: Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Connie, Sasha, Historia. Classmates from training are mixed into the pursuing column. The mixed faces are not ready to see Reiner and Bertholdt as enemies. Erwin does not remove the faces that are not ready. The reason he does not remove them is that he needs eyes that know the scene. The needed eyes waver at the same time. Armin fixes the wavering eyes with words. The words he fixes them with are that the identity is already known. Only the procedure after knowing remains.

vocab.exampleJa: いる理由は、マルコのあとで選んだ翼が、今日も追跡を含むからです。
vocab.exampleEn: The advance party sees the entrance of the forest ahead of the main body. The work of seeing is to return the enemy's speed to the main body. The smoke and messengers that return it are the pulse of the hunt. If the pulse breaks, the armor disappears. To keep it from disappearing, a few people take on a dangerous lead. Jean is among the faces that take it on. The reason he is there is that the wings he chose after Marco still include pursuit today. He no longer compares the wings that include it with a comfortable seat in the interior.

vocab.exampleJa: 戦力という言葉を、ハンネスは隣で人間の名に聞き換えます。
vocab.exampleEn: Sending a pursuing squad needs permission from both the garrison and the survey. Pyxis gives the needed permission, briefly. The reason for giving it is that Eren is the greatest fighting power inside the walls. Beside him, Hannes translates the word fighting power into a human name. Even translated, the commander's judgment is the same. The same judgment gathers horses and blades at the southern gate. The speed of gathering is the first technique of today's hunt. The technique shaves away the time for mourning.

personalUse: Original study narration for Jeremy. Vocabulary and plot beats were taken from a private reading of the episode. The anime's dialogue is not included.
